en: Vintage illustrated postcard showing the harbor and skyline of Riga with sailing ships in the foreground and a row of pastel-colored buildings and church spires along the waterfront. The image is bordered by handwritten cursive text across the top, bottom, and right side. Printed captions include the name of the city in Cyrillic and Latin, and the river name in German.
